title: Log-free model screenshots + actions behind the log
goal: Model-bound screenshots capture the browser window's surface (live log, soft keyboard and system bars excluded) with a full-display + black-fill fallback; actions at points covered by the live log or IME use page a11y node actions (ACTION_CLICK / focus+SET_TEXT / IME enter), covered scrolls move to an uncovered point, and a covered point with no actionable node fails loudly instead of pressing the overlay. Coordinates add the captured window's origin. No phone run, no Riga goal, no UI redesign, no old-engine deletion.
stoppingCondition: Window-scoped capture primary with recorded scope + fallback; box fractions map through the window origin; zero raw tap() calls for covered points (JVM-pinned); text typing works behind the log; gates green incl. WI1_window_scoped_capture.newFile: app/src/main/kotlin/navigator/app/harness/vision/CaptureWindowPolicy.kt — PURE (no Android types): Candidate(id, packageName, isFocused, isActive, isApplicationWindow, left, top, right, bottom) → Target(id, packageName, l/t/r/b). select() keeps BrowserPackages.isBrowser(pkg) AND isApplicationWindow AND positive area; prefers focused, then active, then first lawful in list order (topmost-first); a null package is never lawful; null return = no target.
WI1_window_scoped_capture.visionCapture: browserWindowTarget() only when service.rootInActiveWindow?.packageName is an allowlisted browser; enumerates service.windows, reads w.id / w.type == TYPE_APPLICATION / w.isFocused / w.isActive / null-safe w.root?.packageName / getBoundsInScreen; feeds CaptureWindowPolicy. rawWindowCapture(windowId) via takeScreenshotOfWindow with the same main-looper executor + callback shape as rawCapture. ONE shared retry helper: one 400 ms retry on a synchronously thrown UnsupportedOperationException and one 400 ms retry on ERROR_TAKE_SCREENSHOT_INTERVAL_TIME_SHORT; every other failure final. Flow: target exists → window capture; ANY window failure → the existing full-display capture (existing exclusion black-fill) with the reason in the source; no target → plain display; a display failure still throws (the loop degrades to text-only). VisionCaptureException gained errorCode: Int? = null (both onFailure callbacks pass it).
WI1_window_scoped_capture.screenShot: Appended defaults originX: Int = 0, originY: Int = 0, source: String = "display" (all existing positional constructors/tests compile unchanged). screenWidth/Height = the captured scope's pre-scale dims (window bounds on a window capture, full display otherwise). Sources: window:<pkg>:id=<id>:bounds=<l,t,r,b> / display / display:log-excluded / display:fallback=<reason>. Exclusion applies ONLY on the display path; the frame keeps its full size.
WI1_window_scoped_capture.evidence: VisionEvidence.screenshot line = `screenshot #<i> <w>x<h> scope=<source> sha256=<16>` (the existing -> path / (memory-only) suffix kept).
WI1_window_scoped_capture.loop: VisionLoop.captureSafely logs the first frame's source once to the live log (`[vision] screen: <source>`), reset per run; the exclusion-unavailable note now says it only matters for a display fallback frame.

WI3_behind_log_actions.pureHelpers: VisionMath.coveredAt(rects, x, y, margin) — point inside any rect grown by margin; tappableNodeAt(nodes, x, y) — smallest-area node containing the point with clickable || editable, browser chrome INCLUDED; uncoveredPoint(rects, area, margin): Pair<Int, Int>? — first uncovered candidate (centre, upper third, left third, upper-left sixth, lower third); NULL when EVERY candidate is covered (review amendment: no best-effort centre — the caller refuses).
WI3_behind_log_actions.visionLoop: Covered-point guard after the gate, before dispatch: coveredBounds: (() -> List<RectPx>)? = null read once per step, margin OCCLUSION_MARGIN_PX = 16. Covered TAP → VisionMath.tappableNodeAt; none → Attempted.Failed("tap target (x,y) is covered by the live log or keyboard and no actionable page node exists there; refusing a touch that would land on the overlay"); else executor.clickNode(x,y), false → loud Failed naming the page node; step marker (behind-log: node click), evidence `covered action: tap (x,y) -> node click`. Covered tap-converted TYPE → focus tap SKIPPED, marker `(focus tap skipped: behind-log)`, enterText still at the resolved field centre. Covered/any SCROLL routes through the private shared `scrollStart(occluders, shot, x, y)` helper: uncovered → the intended point unchanged; covered → first uncovered point inside the captured frame, marker `(behind-log: moved to (x,y))`; NULL (all candidates covered or no frame) → loud Failed (`scroll start (x,y) is covered by the live log or keyboard and no uncovered point exists inside the captured frame; refusing a touch that would land on the overlay`), NO dispatch. THE STUCK PROBE (run()'s static-screen scroll) uses the SAME helper: uncovered → exactly today's scroll; covered with a safe point → scroll there + evidence `stuck probe: covered start -> moved to (x,y)`; covered with NO safe point → NO executor.scroll, log/evidence `stuck probe skipped: covered start and no uncovered point`, then the existing still-static consecutiveFailures path. Native TYPE/SUBMIT/BACK unchanged. Null seam = the pre-VEXP5 dispatch (byte-identical); empty list = nothing covers the page.

deviations: ORCHESTRATOR REVIEW FIX 1 (2026-10-18): the stuck probe's scroll WAS an unguarded raw touch (`executor.scroll(nodes.lastOrNull()?.centerX ?: 540, 1200, down = true)`). It now routes through the same private `scrollStart(...)` helper as the ACT SCROLL branch: a null coveredBounds or an uncovered point dispatches exactly as before; a covered start with a safe point scrolls there (evidence `stuck probe: covered start -> moved to (x,y)`); a covered start with NO safe point dispatches NOTHING, logs + evidences `stuck probe skipped: covered start and no uncovered point`, and falls through to the existing still-static `consecutiveFailures = config.stepFailuresBeforeReplan` path.

ORCHESTRATOR REVIEW FIX 2 (2026-10-18): `VisionMath.uncoveredPoint` changed to `Pair<Int, Int>?` and returns NULL when every candidate is covered (the previous best-effort centre fallback is gone). The ACT SCROLL branch then returns the prescribed loud failure (`scroll start (x,y) is covered by the live log or keyboard and no uncovered point exists inside the captured frame; refusing a touch that would land on the overlay`) with zero dispatch. `scrollStart` likewise returns null for a covered start with no shot frame, so the no-frame case keeps the loud refusal.

The tap refusal text interpolates the actual point (`($x,$y)`) where the phase doc wrote the `(x,y)` placeholder — the codebase's existing loud-cause style (e.g. `no editable field at the raw point (650,1250)`); both required phrases are verbatim.

A display FALLBACK frame that also painted the live log keeps `display:fallback=<reason>` as its source: the phase doc's vocabulary has no combined fallback+excluded form. The exclusion still applies (the display path); the fallback reason is the more load-bearing evidence.

windowSource/fallbackReason/SOURCE_* constants live in VisionCapture.Companion (pure string helpers beside the capture they describe) rather than a new file; the phase doc named CaptureWindowPolicy for the pure decision and VisionCapture for the capture.

The retry helper grants one 400 ms retry PER condition kind (one for a synchronously thrown UnsupportedOperationException, one for ERROR_TAKE_SCREENSHOT_INTERVAL_TIME_SHORT) rather than one shared retry total; each catches a distinct platform quirk and the doc lists both.
The covered-click-rejected failure message names the resolved page node id (the doc only prescribed a loud Failed); zero touches either way.

captureSafely's first-frame source line goes to the live log only (`[vision] screen: <source>`), per the doc's wording; it is not duplicated into the evidence event (the evidence already carries `scope=` on the screenshot line).

The new test cases live in three NEW $0 files (CaptureWindowPolicyTest / VisionOcclusionTest / VisionLoopBehindLogTest) rather than extending the existing vision test files — same package, scripted transport, fabricated ScreenShot, no device/provider call.
